recipes.name: Massaman Beef Curry
recipes.description: Slow Persian-influenced southern curry: beef, potato, peanut, cinnamon warmth.

ingredients.name: Palm sugar, tamarind, fish-free soy (veg note n/a beef)

steps.instruction: Crack coconut cream; fry paste till split-fragrant.
Beef sear; milk + season; braise 90 min.
Potato + peanut 30 min; balance sweet-sour-salty.

videos.videoTitle: Beef Massaman Curry Recipe มัสมั่นเนื้อ - Hot Thai Kitchen!

recipes.name: Panang Neua
recipes.description: Thicker, sweeter peanut-kaffir red curry with seared beef.

steps.instruction: Fry paste in cream till oil splits.
Beef in; cook through; rest of milk + peanuts.
Reduce thick; lime-sliver crown.

videos.videoTitle: Panang Curry Beef Recipe พะแนงเนื้อ - Thai Recipes - Hot Thai Kitchen

recipes.name: Pad See Ew with Beef
recipes.description: Charred wide noodles, Chinese broccoli, soy-dark glaze.

ingredients.name: See ew sauce (soy dark/light, oyster-free mushroom stir)

steps.instruction: Sear beef; noodles char flat 1 min.
Kana stems then leaves.
Sauce splash; toss charry.

videos.videoTitle: Pad See Ew Beef | At The Best Thai Food in Delft | With Michell's Keuken | Jan Tom Yam

recipes.name: Thai Beef Salad (Neua Nam Tok)
recipes.description: 'Waterfall' grilled-beef salad with lime-chili-toasted rice.

ingredients.name: Nam tok dressing: fish-free soy-lime-roasted chili-rice powder

steps.instruction: Grill medium-rare; rest; slice against grain.
Dress warm meat with herbs.
Rice-powder dusting last second.

videos.videoTitle: The REAL Steak Salad - Thai "Waterfall" Salad เนื้อย่างน้ำตก

recipes.name: Pad Kra Pao
recipes.description: Stir-fried holy basil with minced pork and fried egg

steps.instruction: Heat oil and fry garlic and chili until fragrant.
Add minced pork and stir-fry until cooked.
Season with oyster sauce and fish sauce.
Toss in holy basil, serve with rice and fried egg.

videos.videoTitle: The "Original" Thai Basil Stir Fry (Pad Kra Pao)

recipes.name: Khao Soi Moo
recipes.description: Northern Thai coconut curry noodles with crispy pork

steps.instruction: Boil noodles and set aside.
Cook curry paste with coconut milk.
Add crispy pork and simmer.
Serve over noodles with shallots, lime, and pickled greens.

videos.videoTitle: Make Khao Soi Moo at Home with this DIY Thai Noodle Kit! | ClickTheCity

recipes.name: Som Tum Moo
recipes.description: Green papaya salad with crispy pork

steps.instruction: Shred green papaya.
Pound garlic, chili, long beans in a mortar.
Add papaya, tomatoes, and pound lightly.
Dress with fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar.

recipes.name: Pad Ped Moo
recipes.description: Spicy red curry stir-fry with pork and bamboo shoots

steps.instruction: Stir-fry red curry paste until fragrant.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add bamboo shoots, coconut milk, and kaffir lime.
Simmer and finish with Thai basil and fish sauce.

recipes.name: Larb Moo
recipes.description: Spicy minced pork salad with herbs and toasted rice

steps.instruction: Cook minced pork with a little water.
Cool slightly, add shallots, herbs.
Season with lime juice, fish sauce, chili flakes.
Toss with toasted rice powder.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Larb Moo (Thai Spicy Pork Salad) - Street Food Style at Home

recipes.name: Moo Yang
recipes.description: Grilled marinated pork skewers

steps.instruction: Marinate sliced pork in coriander root, garlic, pepper, oyster sauce, and sugar.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill over medium coals, basting with marinade.
Serve with jaew dipping sauce.

videos.videoTitle: 🔥 Juicy Thai Grilled Pork Neck | Authentic Moo Yang Recipe #food #thaidish #kitchentoplate

recipes.name: Moo Daeng
recipes.description: Red BBQ pork served over rice

steps.instruction: Marinate pork with red coloring, coriander root, garlic, and oyster sauce.
Grill or roast until charred and cooked.
Slice thinly.
Serve over jasmine rice with cucumber and sauce.

recipes.name: Tom Saap Moo
recipes.description: Spicy and sour Isaan pork rib soup

steps.instruction: Boil pork ribs with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime.
Add chili and season with fish sauce and lime juice.
Simmer until ribs are tender.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

recipes.name: Naem Khao
recipes.description: Crispy rice ball salad with sour sausage

steps.instruction: Form rice into balls, coat with coconut and curry paste.
Deep-fry until golden and crispy.
Crumble into a bowl with sliced sausage, peanuts, and shallots.
Dress with lime juice and fish sauce.

recipes.name: Sai Oua
recipes.description: Northern Thai herb sausage with lemongrass and kaffir lime

steps.instruction: Blend lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime, chili, and coriander root.
Mix spice paste with pork mince.
Stuff into casings and tie into links.
Grill over charcoal until cooked through.

recipes.name: Gaeng Jow Haeng
recipes.description: Northern Thai dried pork curry

steps.instruction: Rehydrate dried pork.
Fry curry paste in coconut cream.
Add pork, shallots, and tomatoes.
Simmer with remaining coconut milk until thick.

recipes.name: Pad Ped Nuea
recipes.description: Spicy stir-fried beef with Thai basil and green beans

steps.instruction: Flash-fry garlic and chilies in hot wok.
Add beef and green beans stir-fry on high heat.
Season with oyster sauce and fish sauce finish with Thai basil.

recipes.name: Larb Nuea
recipes.description: Spicy Isan beef salad with fresh herbs and lime

steps.instruction: Cook minced beef in a hot pan until just done.
Mix with lime juice fish sauce and sliced chilies.
Toss with fresh herbs shallot and toasted rice powder.

recipes.name: Neua Nam Tok
recipes.description: Grilled beef salad with lime dressing and mint

steps.instruction: Grill beef steak over high heat until medium rare.
Slice beef thinly against the grain.
Toss with lime juice fish sauce chilies herbs and rice powder.

recipes.name: Pad See Ew Moo
recipes.description: Stir-fried wide rice noodles with pork and egg

steps.instruction: Stir-fry noodles on high heat until slightly charred.
Add pork and egg push noodles aside to cook egg.
Toss with Chinese broccoli and sauces until well combined.

recipes.name: Pad Mee Korat
recipes.description: Spicy Isaan-style stir-fried thin noodles

steps.instruction: Stir-fry pork with chilies until fragrant.
Add noodles and toss with tamarind and fish sauce.
Top with bean sprout and green onion serve immediately.

recipes.name: Pad Krapow Gai
recipes.description: Holy-basil chicken with chilies over rice and crisp-edged egg.

steps.instruction: Chili-garlic oil blast.
Chicken brown hard; sauces; basil wilt off heat.
Crisp-lace egg on rice; pour over.

recipes.name: Green Curry Chicken
recipes.description: Coconut-green curry with Thai eggplant and basil.

steps.instruction: Split cream; fry paste fragrant.
Chicken seal; milk; simmer 12 min.
Vegetables 6 min; basil off heat.

recipes.name: Khao Man Gai
recipes.description: Chicken-oil rice with poached chicken and ginger-soy dip.

ingredients.name: Jasmine rice cooked in chicken-fat stock

steps.instruction: Poach chicken gently; ice shock; keep broth.
Rice cooked with fat-rendered broth.
Slice chicken; sauce-heavy plate.

recipes.name: Tom Kha Gai
recipes.description: Galangal-coconut chicken soup, sour-silky balance.

steps.instruction: Simmer aromatics in thin milk 5 min.
Chicken + mushrooms tender 8 min.
Thick milk off-boil; lime last to keep green.

recipes.name: Gai Yang
recipes.description: Isaan-style grilled chicken marinated in garlic and coriander

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in garlic, coriander root, pepper, fish sauce, sugar, and lime.
Rest for at least 2 hours.
Grill over charcoal, turning frequently.
Serve with som tum and sticky rice.

recipes.name: Gai Pad Prik Gaeng
recipes.description: Stir-fried chicken with red curry paste and bamboo

steps.instruction: Stir-fry curry paste in oil until fragrant.
Add sliced chicken and cook until white.
Add bamboo shoots and kaffir lime.
Finish with Thai basil and fish sauce.

recipes.name: Gai Lemongrass
recipes.description: Lemongrass marinated grilled chicken

steps.instruction: Mince lemongrass and garlic into a paste.
Marinate chicken with lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar, turmeric, and lime.
Grill over medium heat until golden.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Gai Tod
recipes.description: Thai-style fried chicken with crispy batter

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in garlic, coriander, pepper, and fish sauce.
Coat in flour-rice flour mix.
Deep-fry at 170C until golden and crispy.
Drain and serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Gai Pad King
recipes.description: Stir-fried chicken with ginger and vegetables

steps.instruction: Slice chicken and marinate briefly in soy sauce.
Stir-fry ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until nearly done.
Add vegetables and oyster sauce, stir-fry until done.

recipes.name: Gai Massaman
recipes.description: Southern Thai Massaman curry with chicken and potatoes

steps.instruction: Fry curry paste in coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chicken and brown lightly.
Add coconut milk, potatoes, onion, and peanuts.
Simmer until tender, season with tamarind and palm sugar.

recipes.name: Pad Mee Kuay
recipes.description: Stir-fried flat rice noodles with chicken and egg

steps.instruction: Soak noodles in warm water.
Stir-fry garlic and chicken.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and oyster sauce.
Push aside, scramble egg, mix together with bean sprouts.

recipes.name: Gai Jaw
recipes.description: Deep-fried chicken wings with five-spice

steps.instruction: Marinate wings in five-spice, garlic, and fish sauce.
Coat lightly in flour.
Deep-fry until golden and crispy.
Serve with sweet chili sauce.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Gai
recipes.description: Spicy and sour chicken soup with lemongrass

steps.instruction: Boil chicken broth with lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime.
Add chicken and mushrooms.
Cook until chicken is done.
Season with lime juice and fish sauce, add chili.

recipes.name: Gaeng Dang
recipes.description: Thai red curry with chicken and bamboo shoots

steps.instruction: Saute red curry paste in coconut cream until fragrant.
Add coconut milk chicken and bamboo shoots.
Simmer until cooked through finish with basil and fish sauce.

recipes.name: Gai Tod Himalayan
recipes.description: Crispy fried chicken marinated with Himalayan spices

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with garlic ginger cumin and turmeric.
Coat in rice flour and rest for thirty minutes.
Deep fry until golden and crispy drain and serve.

recipes.name: Pad Thai Kai
recipes.description: Classic Thai stir-fried rice noodles with chicken

steps.instruction: Soak noodles and stir-fry chicken until cooked.
Add noodles tamarind sauce and toss with egg.
Serve with bean sprout crushed peanuts and lime wedge.

recipes.name: Pad See Ew Kai
recipes.description: Stir-fried wide noodles with chicken and egg

steps.instruction: Stir-fry noodles on high heat until slightly charred.
Add chicken and egg push noodles aside to cook egg.
Toss with Chinese broccoli and sauces until well combined.

recipes.name: Kuay Tiew Kai
recipes.description: Clear chicken noodle soup with fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Cook noodles and blanch in hot broth.
Slice chicken breast and arrange over noodles.
Ladle hot broth over garnish with herbs and garlic oil.

recipes.name: Gai Yang Bangkok
recipes.description: Bangkok-style lemongrass grilled chicken

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with lemongrass garlic and cilantro root.
Grill over medium heat turning occasionally.
Serve with sweet chili sauce and fresh lime wedge.

recipes.name: Pad Tua Fak
recipes.description: Stir-fried gourd with fermented soybean paste

steps.instruction: Slice tua fak into thin half-moons.
Stir-fry garlic and fermented soybean until fragrant.
Add tua fak and stir-fry until just tender season and serve.

recipes.name: Pad Thai (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Tamarind noodles with tofu and peanuts - no shrimp needed.

steps.instruction: Tofu golden; push aside; sauce bloom.
Noodles toss till supple; splash water if needed.
Sprouts/chives raw-crunch; peanut-lime finish.

recipes.name: Som Tam (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Green papaya pound salad - skip dried shrimp for veg version.

steps.instruction: Pound garlic-chili coarse.
Beans-tomato bruise lightly.
Papaya in; dress while pounding-turning.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Hed (Mushroom)
recipes.description: Hot-sour clear soup loaded with mushrooms, no shrimp required.

ingredients.name: Vegan tom yum paste or soy-based

steps.instruction: Aromatics simmer in water/stock 5 min.
Mushrooms 6 min; paste dissolve.
Off heat lime; taste hot-sour-salty trinity.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Tom Yum Soup Recipe | Thai Recipes by Mark Wiens (มาร์ค วีนส์)

recipes.name: Pineapple Fried Rice (Vegetarian)
recipes.description: Curry-yellow fried rice with pineapple, cashews, raisins.

steps.instruction: Curry powder bloom in oil.
Rice fry separate grains.
Pineapple-cashew-raisin tumble; serve hollowed pineapple optional.

recipes.name: Pad Thai Jay
recipes.description: Vegetarian pad thai with tofu and peanuts

steps.instruction: Soak noodles in warm water.
Stir-fry tofu until golden.
Add noodles, tamarind sauce, sugar, and fish sauce.
Toss with bean sprouts, peanuts, and lime.

recipes.name: Som Tum Jay
recipes.description: Vegetarian green papaya salad

steps.instruction: Shred green papaya.
Pound garlic, chili, and long beans.
Add papaya, tomatoes, peanuts, and pound lightly.
Season with lime juice, soy sauce, and palm sugar.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Green Papaya Salad (Som tum) Authentic Thai Isaan Style - ส้มตำอีสาน What the food

recipes.name: Gaeng Keow Wan Jay
recipes.description: Vegetarian green curry with tofu and vegetables

steps.instruction: Fry green curry paste in coconut cream.
Add tofu and cook until edges crisp.
Add coconut milk, bamboo shoots, and eggplant.
Simmer and finish with Thai basil and kaffir lime.

recipes.name: Pad Pak Bung
recipes.description: Stir-fried morning glory with garlic and chili

steps.instruction: Heat oil in a very hot wok.
Stir-fry garlic and chili for 10 seconds.
Add morning glory and stir-fry vigorously.
Season with oyster sauce and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tod Mun Pla
recipes.description: Thai fish cakes with kaffir lime and lemongrass

steps.instruction: Mix fish paste with curry paste, minced lemongrass, and kaffir lime.
Fold in diced long beans.
Shape into small patties.
Pan-fry until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Pla Pao
recipes.description: Salt-crusted grilled whole fish with lemongrass

steps.instruction: Stuff fish cavity with lemongrass, kaffir lime, and ginger.
Pack salt all over the fish.
Grill over charcoal until salt crust hardens.
Crack open salt, serve fish with lime.

recipes.name: Laab Pla
recipes.description: Spicy fish salad with herbs and toasted rice

steps.instruction: Poach or grill fish, then flake.
Mix with shallots and herbs.
Season with lime juice, fish sauce, and chili flakes.
Toss with toasted rice powder.

recipes.name: Pla Ning
recipes.description: Sun-dried grilled fish glazed with tamarind

steps.instruction: Score fish and grill until nearly done.
Mix tamarind, sugar, fish sauce, garlic, and chili.
Brush glaze on fish and grill until caramelized.
Serve with steamed rice.

recipes.name: Pad Tua Fak Yao
recipes.description: Stir-fried long beans with egg and chili

steps.instruction: Cut long beans into 2-inch lengths.
Stir-fry garlic and chili in hot oil.
Add long beans and cook until slightly charred.
Season with oyster sauce and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Kaeng Matsaman
recipes.description: Massaman curry with vegetables and peanuts

steps.instruction: Fry curry paste in coconut cream.
Add sweet potato, chickpeas, and coconut milk.
Simmer until potato is tender.
Season with tamarind and palm sugar, add peanuts.

recipes.name: Som Tum Poo
recipes.description: Spicy papaya salad with salted crab

steps.instruction: Shred green papaya.
Pound garlic, chili, long beans.
Add papaya, tomatoes, salted crab.
Season with lime juice, fish sauce, and palm sugar.

recipes.name: Panang Tofu
recipes.description: Rich Panang curry with tofu and kaffir lime

steps.instruction: Fry curry paste in thick coconut cream.
Add tofu and cook until edges crisp.
Add remaining coconut milk and simmer.
Finish with kaffir lime, basil, peanuts, and lime.

recipes.name: Kai Jeow
recipes.description: Fluffy Thai-style omelette with fish sauce

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with fish sauce and white pepper.
Heat oil in a wok until very hot.
Pour eggs and fry until puffy and golden drain and serve.

recipes.name: Tod Mun Jay
recipes.description: Vegetarian Thai fish cakes made with tofu

steps.instruction: Mash tofu and mix with curry paste and rice flour.
Fold in sliced green beans and kaffir lime leaf.
Shape into patties and pan-fry until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Kaeng Leung Jay
recipes.description: Thai vegetarian sour yellow curry

steps.instruction: Saute yellow curry paste in a small amount of coconut milk.
Add remaining coconut milk tofu and vegetables.
Simmer until tender season with tamarind and serve.

recipes.name: Pad Pak Ruam
recipes.description: Stir-fried mixed vegetables in oyster-style sauce

steps.instruction: Heat wok with oil and fry garlic until fragrant.
Add hard vegetables first then softer ones.
Season with soy sauce and sugar stir-fry until just tender.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
recipes.description: Warm coconut sticky rice with ripe mango and salty coconut cream.

steps.instruction: Steam rice covered 25-30 min.
Fold sweet coconut milk into hot rice; rest 20 min covered.
Fan slices alongside; salted cream drizzle.

videos.videoTitle: How To Make Thai Mango Sticky Rice - ThaiChef food

recipes.name: Khanom Krok
recipes.description: Coconut-rice batter pancakes crispy outside custardy inside.

steps.instruction: Oil wells; base batter half-fill.
Cream layer when edges set.
Cover till tops set; scoop half-moons; cool slightly.

recipes.name: Khanom Buang
recipes.description: Crispy Thai crepes with sweet and savory filling

steps.instruction: Mix rice flour, tapioca, and water into a thin batter.
Cook thin crepes on a hot pan.
Top with sweet coconut cream and mung bean.
Fold and serve crispy.

recipes.name: Sangkhaya
recipes.description: Thai coconut custard steamed in pumpkin

steps.instruction: Scoop out pumpkin, leaving a shell.
Mix coconut milk, sugar, and tapioca.
Pour custard into pumpkin shell.
Steam for 30 minutes until set.

recipes.name: Luk Chup
recipes.description: Mini fruit-shaped mung bean desserts in shiny glaze

steps.instruction: Cook mashed mung bean with sugar and coconut milk.
Shape into small fruit shapes.
Dip in colored agar glaze.
Let set and serve.

recipes.name: Khao Lam
recipes.description: Sticky rice with coconut milk in bamboo tubes

steps.instruction: Soak rice and black beans overnight.
Mix with coconut milk and sugar.
Fill bamboo tubes and seal.
Roast over charcoal until cooked through.

recipes.name: Khanom Thong Mok
recipes.description: Thai steamed coconut custard in banana leaf

steps.instruction: Mix coconut milk rice flour and sugar until smooth.
Pour into banana leaf cups.
Steam for twenty minutes until set and serve warm.

recipes.name: Malaeng Mut
recipes.description: Sweet tofu pudding with coconut syrup and toppings

steps.instruction: Cook tapioca pearls until translucent and drain.
Warm coconut milk with pandan leaf and palm sugar.
Serve tofu with tapioca pearls and coconut syrup.

recipes.name: Pa Thong Ko
recipes.description: Thai-style crispy fried dough sticks for dipping

steps.instruction: Mix flour yeast sugar and soy milk into a soft dough.
Rest dough for one hour then shape into strips.
Deep fry until puffy and golden serve with condensed milk.

recipes.name: Khanom Maw Kaeng
recipes.description: Thai coconut custard tart with egg and palm sugar

steps.instruction: Melt palm sugar with coconut milk and cool slightly.
Whisk in eggs flour butter and vanilla.
Pour into tart shells and bake until set and golden.
